summary: A solid, production-plausible SLO platform that sensibly reuses a Prometheus-compatible backend for all SLI math via recording/alerting rules and Alertmanager for routing/dedupe. It covers the core SRE practices (error budgets, multi-window burn rates, governance, and GitOps) with a pragmatic control-plane/data-plane split.
strengths: Strong use of existing Prometheus/Alertmanager primitives to avoid building a bespoke evaluation/alerting engine, improving correctness and operability
Good operational thinking: multi-window burn-rate alerts, data-quality gating, versioned config with audit logs/RBAC, and failure-mode analysis
weaknesses: Scale/cost risks are under-specified: per-SLO/per-window rules and derived series can explode (cardinality + ruler load), and the document lacks concrete sizing/limits and sharding/rollout strategies
A few correctness edge cases need tightening (e.g., PromQL 0/0 and missing-series behavior, and the ETA formula should incorporate remaining budget rather than just periodSeconds/burn_rate)
